actions.action: Unpot, shake off wet soil, inspect roots and base
Cut away all rotted tissue with sterilized knife/scissors
Dust cuts with cinnamon or sulfur powder
Let plant dry 2-4 days in shaded airy spot to callus
Repot in cactus/succulent mix (with perlite/pumice) in pot with drainage holes
Water only when soil is completely dry, starting after about a week
Scrape off moldy top soil and discard old soil
Set out yellow sticky traps for gnats
If rot reached stem center, separate and replant healthy pups

reason: The answer correctly identifies overwatering root rot with mold and gnats as the main problem, and its core advice matches the confirmed fix: cut away the dark rot, repot in cactus soil and keep it dry; nothing in it is harmful.
